ns2:course.label: International Economics
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the theory of international trade and finance with selected application to current problems of trade policy, balance of payments adjustment, the international monetary system, and globalization issues. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent, or consent of instructor; ECON 303 is recommended.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECON 302 or equivalent, or consent of instructor; ECON 303 is recommended.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Economics or Econometrics & Quant Econ or Computer Science & Economics major(s) or minor(s).
